title: Works great.  3 stars due to expense of filter replacement
text:
Works great. 3 stars due to expense of filter replacement. The cost of these filter replacements are so expensive if you can find them.

I love air purifiers, but the prices of filters are ridiculous.

The filter works well, but the filter needs to be replaced when the light comes on, which doesn't seem to take long.

product_metadata.title: Vornadobaby Purio Nursery Air Purifier with True HEPA Filter, Safety Features, and Soothing Glow
features: THREE STAGE FILTRATION — An activated carbon filter absorbs odors and gases, the True HEPA Filter captures 99. 97% of airborne particles like bacteria, mold and pet dander, and a permanent, washable prefilter extends the life of the True HEPA filter.
EFFICIENT COVERAGE — Purify all the air around baby 6. 3 times per hour for a space up to 125 sq. feet, leaving healthy air for baby’s nursery.

CURIOSITY PROOF — Purio is finger-friendly with no pinch points and an extra-wide, topple-resistant base. Cord storage is concealed in the base, and the controls and filter cover are lockable so parents know the settings remain just as they left them.

EASY OPERATION WITH 3 SPEEDS — The three-speed electronic controls make operating a breeze. Choose a lower setting for quieter operation, or a higher setting for a quick clean and natural rush of airflow that can double as a white noise element.

SLEEP / GLOW MODE — Use the “sleepy time’ setting to automatically quiet to the lowest setting in dark conditions. Turn on Purio’s recessed lighting for a soothing glow, and when a filter change is needed, the glow feature will gently dim and brighten.
SUPERIOR SUPPORT — When you choose one of our Vornado Air Purifiers, you’re investing in superior performance and design that will deliver total satisfaction. If not, we’ll replace it, for 5 years.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: Purio is a powerful air purifier designed especially for the nursery – built for baby, perfect for parents. Purio traps odors and cleans the air in the nursery with True HEPA filtration, removing 99.97% of the airborne contaminants and allergens up to 0.3 microns from baby’s air up to 6.3x each hour. A permanent, washable prefilter extends the life of the HEPA filter, and an Activated Carbon filter helps keep the nursery smelling fresh by adsorbing odors. Three airflow settings allow for excellent control of baby’s environment, and the natural rush of airflow doubles as an excellent white noise element in the nursery. Safety is essential in the nursery, so Purio has concealed, fully covered cord management built right into the base. Tamper resistant controls keep little ones from disrupting parents’ desired settings while the smooth exterior features no sharp edges, no pinch points and an extra stable base. A five year Happy Parent Promise assures every customer a completely satisfactory product experience.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
